# Rotations

Futsal detail that travels.

## Rule

The four move so someone is always free. Pass, then take the space the passer left, or the space the defender left when they followed. Two players occupying the same pocket is a rotation failure.

## Cue

After you pass, you are unemployed. Find the next job. Standing is the error.
